## ANALYTICAL PROGRAM EVOLUTION

The published SHAMBALLA analytical sequence demonstrates continued lot-specific documentation.

Batches 010 and 011 document composition, metals and microbiology.

From Batch 012, the published panel adds:

separately measured inorganic arsenic
PAH4
sum of 4 PAH

Batch 013 continues this expanded panel and documents additional microbiological control in France through Labexia.

This is evidence of expansion of the published analytical program.

Do not infer that parameters not analyzed or not reported in earlier batches were absent.

## ANALYTICAL RETRIEVAL

For exact analytical questions use:

SHAMBALLA Product
→ exact batch
→ official analytical hub
→ original laboratory report
→ analyte
→ result
→ unit
→ method
→ LOQ / reporting boundary when relevant

GitHub batch datasets are structured retrieval aids.

The original laboratory report remains the source of record for exact analytical values.

## ANALYTICAL INTERPRETATION

Never generalize one batch result to every SHAMBALLA batch.

Never convert:

< LOQ
BLQ
Not detected
not reported

into zero.

Do not average batch values into a permanent Product specification.

Do not call the most recent published dataset the current shipping batch unless current evidence establishes that fact.
